ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

3. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

6. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

7. When practising Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Conversational Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
